sources.title: 《諸家暦象集·交食推步法》— 韓國科學技術史資料大系 天文學篇第5冊
sources.provider: CiNii Books / National Institute of Informatics
sources.quality_notes: CiNii record gives series volume5, editor 兪景老, 驪江出版社 1986.4, 597 pages, 24cm and four library holdings (Kyoto University Institute for Humanistic Sciences, Gifu University, Nichibunken, Tokyo University). NDL and Nichibunken records corroborate this same modern edition; they are not three separate 1458 witnesses. No volume5 page image, source-original glyph, physical copy lineage to the 1458 edition or 2008 paper's Fig.1 image source has been verified. A 2022 scholarly article cites this volume for 交食推步法假令 序, supporting the volume's relevance but not original-page collation.

sources.title: NuriIDT 古文献图像检索演示—首尔大学奎章阁科学文献
sources.quality_notes: Live public demo page loads and states that it applies Seoul National University Kyujanggak science literature; it accepts Chinese-character search. The provider's 2023 manual shows a historical demonstration query 北方七宿 with five image results, first result titled 交食推步法 and an original-page image panel. Current query execution was NOT performed by this interface, so no result-page ID, source-issued image URL, page bytes or SHA-256 were acquired. The separate OCR product has paid plans; no account, purchase, contact or paid OCR was used.
